scenario: The monitored application's container is stopped; ACTION-001 cannot reach its recovery endpoint.

dispatch_to_failed_seconds.unit: s (dispatch -> FAILED, three recovery calls with back-off)

retry_to_verified_seconds.unit: s (retry -> verified result, includes waiting for the alert to clear)
